text: In the small town of Kurouzu-cho, schoolgirl Kirie Goshima watches her boyfriend Shuichi's father fill a video scrapbook with snail shells, whirlpools and anything else that curls, until [he crawls into a washing machine|images|household objects and machines] to die. Soon [the whole town|who_suffers|whole communities] is caught in the spiral. Classmates slow down, sprout shells and climb the school walls as their [bodies twist out of shape|rules|the body changes], a girl's curls take over her mind, and [whirling clouds gather over the funerals|images|weather, sky and darkness].
